message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "R73",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game crashes and forces a restart, which could interrupt play sessions.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This is my first playthrough on mobile. Love this game! However, it has crashed twice today and forced me to restart my day."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R75",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game does not respect gender selection, allowing a child to enter areas meant for girls.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I made my character right and I was a girl but the game think Im a boy… I was about to go into girls but it said “you can not go in there”and I tried Boys I went right threw so how do you be a girl"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R76",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game only allows multiplayer on computer and wants to play with a sibling on mobile.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I love this game it is so fun but you can only play together with friends on computer and I really want to play with my Brother but I don’t want to git it on computer.can you pls make a update to play with friends"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R77",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game has a glitch that can cause loss of progress during festivals and fishing on iPad.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "every time I enter a festival I can’t get out and loose the day. Also when fishing if you don’t tap the hit button in a perfect spot it just pulls the pole out of the water."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R79",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game soft locks on load and cannot be fixed by restarting or reinstalling, causing loss of progress.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "When reloading a save from where you previously left off, the game will soft lock with a frozen image of the last place where the player was. Restarting the game doesn’t fix it, deleting and re-installing the app doesn’t fix it, and saving the game properly to try a different day doesn’t fix it either."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R81",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent suggests a bug where pressing controller X deletes bait instead of returning it to inventory.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Players cannot remove bait from fishing rods with either touch controls or gamepads. Pressing controller X deletes bait directly instead of returning it to inventory."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R82",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the mobile interface is hard to navigate and difficult to exit the game.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Touch screen doesn’t work well and it’s damn difficult to exit the game, I had to shut my phone off to get out."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R84",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the Dynamic Island blocks UI elements, making parts of the interface unusable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "many of the options are blocked by my iPhone’s Dynamic Island. Is there any way to fix this?"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R85",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the character moves on its own and the game is unplayable on iPhone 14 Plus.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "For some reason on my iPhone 14 Plus, I can’t even control my character, it moves on its own, and literally is unplayable."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R87",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports children in the game are not interactive enough and lack meaningful rewards.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I wish the children were much more interactive especially because it’s challenging to get them, so there should be a bigger reward."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R88",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game cannot be launched at all, calling it a waste of money.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This was a waste of money. Impossible to navigate or maybe I’m just too old. Touch screen doesn’t work well and it’s damn difficult to exit the game, I had to shut my phone off to get out."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R89",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports a glitch where giving a second gift to a villager incorrectly counts toward a weekly limit.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "When I tried to give her another one the next day, it said I’ve already given her two gifts this week when in the relationships tab, I’ve only given her one!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R90",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent suggests adding controller support as a requested feature.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Add controller support"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R92",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the UI is too small on iPhone, including tiny text and buttons, and the Dynamic Island interferes with the toolbar.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "the dialogues are very small the buttons, the barra de vida, energía y interfaz igualmente son muy pequeños por más grandes que ponga todas las opciones posibles, ya que tengo un iPhone 16 la isla dinámica también molesta en la barra de herramientas o donde está la fecha y hora"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R94",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent requests the ability to adjust the energy bar location and better inventory controls.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "CONCERNED APE, LET ME ADJUST THE ENERGY BAR LOCATION AND MY LIFE IS YOURS!!! Also, it’d be nice if I didn’t need to use the touchscreen for certain things like sorting my inventory and scrolling through the villager menu."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R97",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game freezes and loses all progress after reaching level 100 in the Skull Cavern.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "My game FROZE and I lost all progress 😭 idk why touching the screen made it freeze, but there was nothing I could do :("
    },
    {
      "ref": "R98",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game requires an internet connection to play, which is a limitation.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It isn't an offine game I can play unless I have service which sucks"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R101",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports visual and sound bugs, such as fishing rod sounds persisting after use.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Hay una gran exageración de errores, entiendo que sea por IOS pero aún así es molesto, errores visuales de cosas que no deberían de estar y errores de sonido, al dejar de usar una caña al interactuar con cosas aun se sigue escuchando la caña de pescar."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R102",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent reports poor controller support, making the game frustrating to play with a controller.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Controller support is the most poorly optimized I have ever seen on any game. Ever. Many of the features are completely inaccessible when using a controller, leading to a frustrating loop of switching between touch controls and a physical controller."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R103",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game incorrectly interprets taps as movement, interfering with fishing.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "whenever I am trying to complete quests or am trying to fish in hotspots."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R105",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game crashes only saves when sleeping, causing loss of a full game day.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "But it only saves when you sleep, and sometimes it crashes and you lose a whole game day. It asks you if you would like to resume… maybe half the time."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R106",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent requests a joystick or on-screen movement stick for easier navigation.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Moving around is a pain. I do not like having to tap everywhere. The character is like a joystick, but they are central to the screen. If I want to move around I have to cover a bunch of my screen"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R107",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is not optimized for iPhone 15 Pro's notch/hole punch design.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Great game but game isn’t properly optimised for the hole punch."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R111",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game crashes and sometimes does not allow resuming after a crash, causing loss of progress.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It asks you if you would like to resume… maybe half the time. Incredibly frustrating. Please fix it"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R112",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the control scheme is unintuitive and covers too much of the screen.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "I would love a joystick in the corner"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R113",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the iOS controls are almost unplayable due to poor layout.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I wish I could get my money back for this app."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R114",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent praises the developer for continuous updates and long-term support.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Im ready for sandy!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R115",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the energy bar is cut off and buttons are too small, making the UI unusable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The energy bar being cut off has apparently been a long standing issue according to forums online going as far back as 2 years which is very unfortunate."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R117",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is highly interactive and rewarding, with a desire for more heart events for children.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I GOT TO MARRY SEBASTIAN 😍😍😍😍😍😍"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R119",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks Arabic language support, preventing a child from playing.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "اللعبة جميله لكن لامكنني لعبها او ان اجعل طفلي يلعبها لعدم وجود اللغة العربية"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R120",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game is too zoomed in on mobile and cannot be fixed due to locked settings.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I was excited to play Stardew Valley but unfortunately I can’t use it on my phone at all. The edges of the screen are too zoomed in and there’s no way to fix it as I can’t access the in-game settings."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R121",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the HUD is poorly optimized on iPhone, with the energy bar cut off and Dynamic Island blocking the hotbar.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The bottom of the energy bar is off screen so I am unsure of when I am actually going to run out of energy causing me to either spend extra money on food or end days early because I don’t know how much energy I have."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R123",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent states the game is worth the cost despite no additional features.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Be a man.buy this"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R125",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent states the game is worth the money and loves it.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "The money is totally worth it"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R126",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent requests better multiplayer features, such as seeing who is online and joining games.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "We need to be able to see who’s on the network and join the active game it can’t be that hard to implement"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R127",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the mobile controls are unintuitive and poorly designed compared to other games.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This mobile version is unfortunately terrible I wish so badly the controls were more comparable to the other versions of the game that I’m used to something like how Roblox has it with the tool bar being at the bottom"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R128",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports confusion over tool icons, with the hoe looking like a hammer or axe.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I'm a new subscriber, so I'm not sure about the rating yet, but I have a problem visualizing your tools. Your hoe looks like an axe or a hammer."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R129",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game lacks Arabic language support, preventing a child from playing.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "اللعبة جميله لكن لامكنني لعبها او ان اجعل طفلي يلعبها لعدم وجود اللغة العربية"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R130",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the game cannot be played offline and requires a constant internet connection.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It isn't an offine game I can play unless I have service which sucks"
    }
  ]
}
